subject.title: fix: live updater survives launchd teardown and retargets wrapped gateways

question: Should this combined branch be accepted as the canonical availability-sensitive macOS updater fix instead of the narrower overlapping PR?
rationale: The patch is correct and proof-positive, but the protected label and two divergent open implementations require a human owner to choose the permanent native stop policy and landing branch.

options.title: Land this combined branch
options.body: Accept this PR after exact-head required checks because it covers both reproduced failures and has direct live macOS proof.

options.title: Consolidate into the sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105030 only after moving this PR's unique whole-array plist repair, tests, and live-proof expectations into it.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep both open if the owner wants additional native evidence for a different retry budget or launchd environment before choosing the policy.

recommendation.title: Land this combined branch
recommendation.body: Accept this PR after exact-head required checks because it covers both reproduced failures and has direct live macOS proof.
